popCulture.title: Iliad
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Son of Euaemon: Catalogue leader of forty ships from Ormenius and Hypereia; wounded by Paris, later healed enough to fight again — Homeric Eurypylus, not Telephus' Mysian son.

popCulture.title: Eurypylus (son of Euaemon)
popCulture.description: Achaean captain from Thessaly at Troy — distinct from Eurypylus son of Telephus.
